homepage.layoutDescription.message: Official documentation for the Flagshiiip platform

hero.friendlySubtitle.message: Flagshiiip is a blockchain-powered physical product verification and digital asset ecosystem. Simply scan the smart sticker with a unique QR code on the packaging using your phone camera to instantly verify authenticity, secure official digital ownership certificates, and claim FTN token rewards from your favorite brands.

marquee.title.message: POWERING TOOLS AND INTEGRATION FROM COMPANIES ALL AROUND THE WORLD

steps.subtitle.message: The verification system is designed to be simple and fast without requiring any technical expertise.

steps.step1.desc.message: On product packaging with unique QR code

steps.step2.desc.message: Open the app, then point camera to sticker

steps.step4.desc.message: If the product offers customer rewards

quickLinks.subtitle.message: Choose a topic you would like to explore to get started with Flagshiiip.

quickLinks.scanQr.desc.message: Point your camera at the sticker on the packaging.

quickLinks.verify.desc.message: Understand verification status indicators and digital certificates.

quickLinks.claim.desc.message: Collect digital FTN token rewards from your favorite brands.

quickLinks.help.desc.message: Quick solutions if stickers are damaged or scanning fails.

quickLinks.faq.desc.message: Frequently asked questions about accounts and features.

whyFlagshiiip.subtitle.message: A physical product verification solution providing certainty for buyers and added value from trusted manufacturers.

whyFlagshiiip.benefit1.desc.message: Simply open your phone camera and point it at the product sticker. Authenticity results appear in seconds without special tools.

whyFlagshiiip.benefit2.desc.message: An official digital certificate is stored on your phone as valid proof of ownership whenever you need it.

whyFlagshiiip.benefit3.desc.message: Receive FTN tokens directly to your account from partner brands as appreciation for choosing authentic products.

brandBanner.text.message: Brand owner or official manufacturer? Discover product authenticity protection and partnership programs.

homepage.feature1.description.message: Scan the QR on the packaging to confirm the product is authentic and registered.

homepage.feature2.description.message: Record product ownership and view its digital certificate of authenticity.

homepage.feature3.description.message: A customer loyalty program powered by blockchain technology.

hero.eyebrow.message: PHYSICAL PRODUCT AUTHENTICITY & DIGITAL LOYALTY ECOSYSTEM

hero.hl1.desc.message: Unique smart QR sticker, single claim per item.

hero.hl2.desc.message: Valid ownership proof secured on Polygon blockchain.

hero.hl3.desc.message: Turn shopping loyalty into real digital assets.

comparison.subtitle.message: Barcode hitam-putih biasa sangat mudah difotokopi oleh sindikat pemalsu, dan poin belanja konvensional sering hangus sepihak. Flagshiiip hadir dengan stiker pintar berkunci kriptografi dan hadiah aset digital permanen.

comparison.conventional.desc.message: Sistem lama yang mudah ditiru sindikat barang palsu dan minim perlindungan untuk pembeli.

comparison.flagshiiip.desc.message: Perlindungan total keaslian produk fisik dan program hadiah digital bernilai riil untuk pembeli.

cta.subtitle.message: Pelajari panduan praktis cara memindai kemasan barang belanjaan Anda lewat aplikasi, atau daftarkan merek bisnis Anda untuk memutus rantai pemalsuan dan membangun loyalitas pelanggan bernilai riil.

features.subtitle.message: Tidak perlu mengerti istilah kripto rumit. Flagshiiip dirancang agar siapa pun bisa memastikan keaslian barang belanjaan dan menerima aset digital bernilai hanya dengan satu kali scan kamera ponsel.

workflow.title.part2.message: menjadi aset digital di saku Anda.

workflow.subtitle.message: Dari rak toko ritel hingga hadiah tersimpan di dompet digital Anda, seluruh proses berjalan otomatis tanpa gesekan teknis.
